# CopyImage <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyImage:Int32 image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image to copy. |

**Returns:** A handle for the new image.

## Description

Makes a new image that has the same pictures, handle and mask color as an existing one. Changes to the copy, such as [ScaleImage](ScaleImage), do not change the original, so copy an image before you transform it for several uses.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local original = CreateImage(32, 32)
Local copy = CopyImage(original)
ScaleImage copy, 2, 2
Print ImageWidth(original) + " and " + ImageWidth(copy)
WaitKey
```
